description: Ayse produces a plant growth compound by mixing two types of fertilizer: C and Y. This growth compound must contain at least 5 units of nitrous oxide and 8 units of vitamin mix. Fertilizer C and Y cost $2 and $3 per kg respectively. Fertilizer C contains 1.5 units of nitrous oxide per kg and 3 units of vitamin mix per kg. Fertilizer Y contains 5 units of nitrous oxide per kg and 1 unit of vitamin mix per kg. Determine the minimum cost of Ayse's compound.

NumFertilizers.definition: Number of different fertilizers used in the compound

CostFertilizer.definition: Cost per kilogram of each fertilizer

NitrousOxidePerFertilizer.definition: Units of nitrous oxide per kilogram of each fertilizer

VitaminMixPerFertilizer.definition: Units of vitamin mix per kilogram of each fertilizer

RequiredNitrousOxide.definition: Minimum required units of nitrous oxide in the compound

RequiredVitaminMix.definition: Minimum required units of vitamin mix in the compound

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of the fertilizer mixture used to produce Ayse's compound"

constraints.description: The total units of nitrous oxide provided by all fertilizers must be at least RequiredNitrousOxide
The total units of vitamin mix provided by all fertilizers must be at least RequiredVitaminMix
The amount of each fertilizer used must be non-negative

AmountFertilizer.definition: Amount in kilograms of each fertilizer used in the compound
